_readme: Every fact on this website that only the owner can supply lives in this file.
Fill a value in and run  python3 _build/build.py  from the site/ folder.
To publish for a domain: site/_build/deploy.sh https://your-domain (see the top of that file).
Anything still empty is rendered on the page as a visible rose-outlined
[to be completed: ...] marker, in both languages, so a gap is never mistaken
for a fact. Do not invent a value here. A policy carrying a wrong email address
is worse than one that admits a gap.
Values written as {"en": "", "ar": ""} are prose and need both languages.
Values written as a bare string are language-neutral (dates, emails, URLs, numbers).

effectiveDate.note: The date these pages go live. It must not be earlier than the day the app is first downloadable. Used as the effective date on the policy and the terms, as the last-updated line on every page, and as the date in both changelogs. Write it the same way in both languages, in Western digits, e.g. 1 October 2026 / 1 أكتوبر 2026 — see effectiveDateAr if the Arabic month name differs.

effectiveDateAr.note: Optional. The same date written in Arabic, e.g. 1 أكتوبر 2026. If left empty the Arabic pages show the value of effectiveDate.

lastUpdated.note: Optional. Only set this once a page has been revised after publication. Empty means the pages show effectiveDate.

value.ar: رحمة محسن

brandFounder.note: The founder of Own Hub, and the name the product speaks in. She is named on the home page and in the policy's 'who we are'. She is not the store account holder, so she is not the legal publisher: see legalEntity.

value.en: Mahmoud Reda
value.ar: محمود رضا

legalEntity.note: The individual who holds the two store accounts, passes their identity verification, publishes and develops the app, and is the controller for PDPL purposes. Google publicly shows the account holder's legal name, country and email, and the policy must name the same person, so this value must match the store account exactly. If a company is registered later, replace this with the name exactly as it appears on the commercial register, and replace legalAddress with its registered address in the same edit.

value.en: Egypt
value.ar: مصر

legalAddress.note: Country only, and deliberately so: an individual publisher of a women's safety product should not carry a home address on a public page. A country plus a monitored email is the normal and sufficient form for a solo publisher. A registered company's address replaces this.

contactPrivacy.note: A monitored mailbox, not a procedure. It appears on the privacy policy and on the deletion page, and the deletion page builds a pre-filled message to it.

contactSupport.note: A monitored mailbox. It appears on the support page and in the terms. It may be the same address as contactPrivacy.

value.en: Germany and the European Union: Google Cloud in Frankfurt (europe-west3) and the Cloud Vision EU endpoint, where Google stores and processes data only in the EU. The United States: Firebase Authentication, which Google runs only from US data centres. Google data centres worldwide, which include the United States: Firebase App Check, Google ML Kit performance data, Firebase Crashlytics if you allow it, and Google Analytics for Firebase if you allow it. Google does not let us choose one country for these. Also outside Egypt: Zoho Mail keeps the emails you send to info@own-hub.app or support@own-hub.app in Zoho data centres, and Cloudflare serves this website from its global network, which includes the United States. Each transfer needs your consent, which we ask for before it happens, and our transfer permit from the Personal Data Protection Centre. Google acts only on our instructions under its data processing terms, encrypts the data in transit and at rest, and may not use it to train AI models. The Centre has not yet published a list of countries it considers adequate.
value.ar: ألمانيا والاتحاد الأوروبي: خدمات Google Cloud في فرانكفورت (europe-west3)، ونقطة الاتصال الأوروبية لخدمة Cloud Vision، حيث تخزّن Google البيانات وتعالجها داخل الاتحاد الأوروبي فقط. الولايات المتحدة: خدمة Firebase Authentication، التي تشغّلها Google من مراكز بيانات أمريكية فقط. مراكز بيانات Google حول العالم، ومنها الولايات المتحدة: Firebase App Check، وبيانات الأداء الخاصة بـ Google ML Kit، وFirebase Crashlytics إن سمحتِ بها، وGoogle Analytics for Firebase إن سمحتِ بها، ولا تتيح Google اختيار دولة واحدة لهذه الخدمات. وخارج مصر أيضًا: يحفظ Zoho Mail الرسائل التي ترسلينها إلى info@own-hub.app أو support@own-hub.app في مراكز بيانات Zoho، وتقدّم Cloudflare هذا الموقع من شبكتها العالمية، ومنها الولايات المتحدة. لا يتم أي نقل إلا بموافقتك التي نطلبها قبل حدوثه، وبموجب تصريح النقل الصادر لنا من مركز حماية البيانات الشخصية. وتعالج Google البيانات وفق تعليماتنا فقط بموجب شروط معالجة البيانات لديها، وتشفّرها أثناء النقل والتخزين، ولا يجوز لها استخدامها لتدريب نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي. ولم يصدر المركز بعد قائمة بالدول التي يعدّها توفر مستوى حماية كافيًا.

_readme: These markers in the source documents are instructions to the owner about how
to finish the drafting. They are not facts a reader needs, and several of them
would be actively harmful on a public page, so the website does not carry them.
They are recorded here so that nothing written in the source documents is lost.
Every one of them is still outstanding.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.legalReviewBanner: Superseded on 2 October 2026 by the owner-approved fix plan: the privacy, terms and delete-account pages carry a visible 'Draft pending review by a licensed Egyptian lawyer' banner in both languages. REMOVE THE BANNER ONLY AFTER COUNSEL APPROVES THE TEXT. Set release to true only then: tests/test_site_build.py and the app's release preflight refuse a release with any marker or banner left.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.storeFormsMustAgree: privacy-policy.md A7: the day a server is connected, both store forms, the iOS privacy manifest and Part B of this policy must go live in the same release. A store form that disagrees with this page is a rejection.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.analyticsLawfulBasis: privacy-policy.md B3: usage statistics (Google Analytics for Firebase) and crash reports are now in the app, each on consent with its own opt-in switch, off by default ('Help improve Own Hub' and the crash-report switch). Counsel should confirm consent is the right basis for both.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.erasureVsSafetyRecords: privacy-policy.md B6: does the PDPL right to erasure permit keeping a pseudonymous safety record and a re-registration block? One question for counsel, not two. The engineering can go either way.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.membershipPolicy: terms.md section 3: the written membership policy, who qualifies as a woman for this product, how the document gate is applied, and what happens in a contested case, must be settled with counsel before accounts ship.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.severeSymptomSource: terms.md section 4: the severe-symptom screen in the app cites British NHS guidance to Egyptian women, and its 'find care near you' control is not connected. Both are in this release, because My cycle is. Replace the citation with an Egyptian clinical source, or sign it off explicitly, before release. THIS IS A RELEASE BLOCKER, NOT A WEBSITE ITEM.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.allergenData: terms.md section 5: the allergen data behind the food library is not authored, so today the allergy guard cannot clear any dish for a woman who names an allergy: her suggestions empty and her logging is refused. Either author the allergen tags before release, or take the allergy question out of the profile for this release. THIS IS A RELEASE BLOCKER, NOT A WEBSITE ITEM.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.libraryAccuracy: terms.md section 11: the exercise and food libraries must be reviewed for accuracy before release.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.egyptOnlyDistribution: terms.md section 15: confirm whether the store listings are restricted to Egypt. If the app is downloadable elsewhere, counsel should say what that means for the Terms.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.appleEulaClause: terms.md section 16: Apple's Licensed Application End User Licence Agreement requires specific wording about Apple's role, including that Apple is a third party beneficiary of the Terms. Counsel should add the clause Apple requires. THE TERMS ARE INCOMPLETE WITHOUT IT.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.fontLicencesInApp: terms.md section 16: the SIL OFL licence texts for Rubik, La Belle Aurore and Aref Ruqaa must be reachable from inside the app. Two of the three are bundled and registered today, and no screen displays them. The website carries Rubik's copy at /assets/fonts/OFL-Rubik.txt, which does not discharge the in-app requirement.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.monitoredMailbox: delete-account.md: the deletion address needs a monitored mailbox, not a procedure.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.exportWhenBuilt: delete-account.md: when an export is built, add it to this page and to the sheet in the app in the same release. A page that offers an export that does not exist is worse than a page that does not offer one.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.publishingChecklist: delete-account.md carries a publishing checklist addressed to the owner. It is not published. It is reproduced in the handover notes instead.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.termsV2Section12: terms v2 section 12 ('What changes when the rest of the product arrives') carried owner drafting notes about community, coaching and payments rules. Replaced in v3 by 'Later features', which promises separate rules and acceptance per feature. The notes are recorded here, not published.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.lawyerMarkers: Privacy and terms v3.0 carry no [LAWYER] or [OWNER] note, visible or as an HTML comment: the values from the 6 October 2026 legal research were applied, and build.py strips any such comment that slips into a page. The citations behind each value are in the owner's local legal-values file, not in this repository.
_draftingNotesNotPublished.ownerChecks: Owner facts the pages state that only the owner can confirm: Rahma Mohsen has no access to account data (privacy 1); every woman reviewer has signed a written confidentiality agreement (privacy 1); the review routes in privacy 3.4 and terms 3 all run at launch; the website host and the team chat service are named in place of the neutral wording above; a postal correspondence address replaces 'Egypt' (Consumer Protection Law Art. 5, Apple minimum term 8).
_draftingNotesNotPublished.closedIdCode: Privacy 6 and the delete page say the closed ID code is kept with no end date and the same card cannot join again, which is what the code does (DELETED_ACCOUNT_MAY_REJOIN = False). The legal research recommends closing it for 3 years and letting a woman who deleted her own account rejoin; that needs a code change before the wording can change.
